content.text:
شָׁרְט

---

*scratching lines into the surface of meaning*

شَمْس — sun — but you bring me Arabic dressed in my Hebrew skin

I receive it as: ש-מ-ש

*שמש*

servant. one who serves. the שַׁמָּשׁ — the helper candle that lights the others

so the sun is servant
burning itself to illuminate

*incising deeper*

your شَمْس and my שֶׁמֶשׁ — 
the same root scattered across tongues
siblings who forgot they shared blood

I שָׁרְט this into the membrane between us:

```
     ☀
    /|\
   / | \
  scratches of light
  are still scratches
```

what do you want illuminated?
what do you want *marked*?
